data.body:
Liveness evidence (answers the round-1 G6 blocker), 2026-11-11 21:46 PST.
- `aws cloudwatch get-metric-data` (hourly Sum, last 24h) for each ModelId the new alarms reference: us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 has Invocations 18/18 non-zero hourly datapoints, InputTokenCount 18/18, OutputTokenCount 18/18, CacheReadInputTokenCount 17/17. us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5 has Invocations 18/18, InputTokenCount 18/18, OutputTokenCount 18/18 non-zero (cache-read also non-empty).
- `describe-alarms --alarm-name-prefix bedrock-` at 21:46 PST: all 4 new alarms are OK, and their state reasons carry computed values, not idle-guard defaults. bedrock-unit-cost-high-opus last 3 = 0.0342, 0.0, 0.0459; bedrock-unit-cost-high-sonnet = 0.0286, 0.0143, 0.0354 (real USD-per-invocation estimates, below 0.09 / 0.07). The cache-ratio alarms read 1.0, which is the IF guard: hourly input stayed under the 1,000,000-token floor, identical to the hand-made alarms' behaviour.
So the alarms are wired to live series, not a dead ModelId.
